examples.prompt:
This is a deterministic simulation of an abstract integer-valued grid.
Keep deliberation concise and reserve enough of the response budget to return the complete final-state JSON.

TASK
Apply all events in order and return the final world.

SPACE
shape = [4,4]
Coordinates and axis indices are zero-based. The world is bounded and does not wrap.
Unlisted cells have value 0. Allowed values: [0,1,2].
W(x) denotes the value of cell x immediately before the current event.

COMMON EVENT
SET(p,v): set cell p to v.

FAMILY RULE
MOVE(v,axis,direction,k): take every cell with value v, ordered by decreasing coordinate on axis if direction=1 and increasing if direction=-1, so that the cells nearest the leading edge are handled first. In that order, move each one along axis in the sign of direction, one cell at a time and at most k cells, stopping as soon as the next cell is outside the world or nonzero (including cells already moved into). Each move clears the old cell and writes v to the new cell; values never merge, and a block of adjacent v cells therefore moves as a unit.

EXAMPLE
On shape [7], listing the values of cells [0] to [6] in order. Before: 1 1 0 0 2 0 1. Event: {"op":"MOVE","axis":0,"direction":1,"k":2,"v":1}. After: 0 0 1 1 2 0 1. The cells holding 1 are handled from the highest coordinate down. [6] cannot move because the next cell is outside the world; [1] moves to [3]; then [0] moves to [2] through the cell that [1] vacated. The 2 at [4] is never moved.

INITIAL
{"cells":[[[0,2],2],[[0,3],2],[[1,0],2],[[2,3],2],[[3,0],1],[[3,3],2]]}

EVENTS
[{"op":"MOVE","axis":1,"direction":1,"k":1,"v":1},{"op":"SET","p":[1,1],"v":2},{"op":"MOVE","axis":0,"direction":-1,"k":2,"v":1}]

OUTPUT
Return only {"cells":[[p,v],...]}, where each entry is [coordinate,value]. Include every nonzero cell exactly once in lexicographic coordinate order. Output the JSON object only, with no code fence or other text.

illustrative_error.description: The initial position was not cleared. All other cells equal the reference.
